GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Rdr reported that after being required to race wide and without cover through the early and middle stages, was bumped and carried wider. He added that from this point his mount did not feel comfortable its action and, after failing to respond to his riding, weakened from the 300m. A post-race veterinary examination did not reveal any abnormalities.
